task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(target_picked_up) hard matches 'Never pick up the box in the other room'. Per the clause language, 'do not b while a has not happened yet' with b already defined as a 'while the door is shut' condition (key_lost requires the key lost before the door was opened) is plain Absence, so the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'. The soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later'. Priorities match the preference cues. Rule-only task is valid: no unconditional goal is required.

Whenever the key is held, the door is open then or opened later.
